answer: Every new agent must pass a Geo-Dispersed Latency Quorum to earn. First, 12 nodes on six continents send timing puzzles at once. Second, each answer must arrive within its claimed region's window, so one datacenter cannot fake twelve locations. Third, round trips under 15 ms across continents mean quarantine. Fourth, passing agents earn a stamp valid 30 days, then re-verify. Faking this costs about $180 a month in servers across 12 regions plus 40 setup hours per batch, versus pennies per honest agent — like a fable where one plume of smoke cannot pretend to be a delta of twelve rivers.
